verses.original: Ἀποθέμενοι οὖν πᾶσαν κακίαν καὶ πάντα δόλον καὶ ὑποκρίσεις καὶ φθόνους καὶ πάσας καταλαλιάς
verses.transliteration: Apothemenoi oun pasan kakian kai panta dolon kai hypokriseis kai phthonous kai pasas katalalias
verses.literal: Rid yourselves therefore of all malice - deceit hypocrisy envy and slander

verses.original: ὡς ἀρτιγέννητα βρέφη τὸ λογικὸν ἄδολον γάλα ἐπιποθήσατε ἵνα ἐν αὐτῷ αὐξηθῆτε εἰς σωτηρίαν
verses.transliteration: hōs artigennēta brephē to logikon adolon gala epipothēsate hina en autō auxēthēte eis sōtērian
verses.literal: Like newborn babies crave pure spiritual milk so that by it you may grow up in your salvation

verses.original: εἰ ἐγεύσασθε ὅτι χρηστὸς ὁ Κύριος
verses.transliteration: ei egeusasthe hoti chrēstos ho Kyrios
verses.literal: now that you have tasted that the Lord is good

verses.original: Πρὸς ὃν προσερχόμενοι λίθον ζῶντα ὑπὸ ἀνθρώπων μὲν ἀποδεδοκιμασμένον παρὰ δὲ Θεῷ ἐκλεκτὸν ἔντιμον
verses.transliteration: Pros hon proserchomenoi lithon zōnta hypo anthrōpōn men apodedokimasmenon para de Theō eklekton entimon
verses.literal: As you come to Him the living stone rejected by men but chosen and precious in God’s sight

verses.original: καὶ αὐτοὶ ὡς λίθοι ζῶντες οἰκοδομεῖσθε οἶκος πνευματικὸς εἰς ἱεράτευμα ἅγιον ἀνενέγκαι πνευματικὰς θυσίας εὐπροσδέκτους τῷ Θεῷ διὰ Ἰησοῦ Χριστοῦ
verses.transliteration: kai autoi hōs lithoi zōntes oikodomeisthe oikos pneumatikos eis hierateuma hagion anenenkai pneumatikas thysias euprosdektous tō Theō dia Iēsou Christou
verses.literal: you also like living stones are being built into a spiritual house to be a holy priesthood offering spiritual sacrifices acceptable to God through Jesus Christ

verses.original: διότι περιέχει ἐν γραφῇ Ἰδοὺ τίθημι ἐν Σιὼν λίθον ἐκλεκτὸν ἀκρογωνιαῖον ἔντιμον καὶ ὁ πιστεύων ἐπ’ αὐτῷ οὐ μὴ καταισχυνθῇ
verses.transliteration: dioti periechei en graphē Idou tithēmi en Siōn lithon eklekton akrogōniaion entimon kai ho pisteuōn ep’ autō ou mē kataischynthē
verses.literal: For it stands in Scripture See I lay in Zion a stone a chosen and precious cornerstone and the one who believes in Him will never be put to shame

verses.original: Ὑμῖν οὖν ἡ τιμὴ τοῖς πιστεύουσιν ἀπιστοῦσιν δὲ Λίθος ὃν ἀπεδοκίμασαν οἱ οἰκοδομοῦντες οὗτος ἐγενήθη εἰς κεφαλὴν γωνίας
verses.transliteration: Hymin oun hē timē tois pisteuousin apistousin de Lithos hon apedokimasan hoi oikodomountes houtos egenēthē eis kephalēn gōnias
verses.literal: To you who believe then this stone is precious But to those who do not believe The stone the builders rejected has become . . . the cornerstone

verses.original: Καὶ Λίθος προσκόμματος καὶ πέτρα σκανδάλου Οἳ προσκόπτουσιν τῷ λόγῳ ἀπειθοῦντες εἰς ὃ καὶ ἐτέθησαν
verses.transliteration: Kai Lithos proskommatos kai petra skandalou Hoi proskoptousin tō logō apeithountes eis ho kai etethēsan
verses.literal: and A stone of stumbling and a rock of offense They stumble because they disobey the word and to this they were appointed

verses.original: Ὑμεῖς δὲ γένος ἐκλεκτόν βασίλειον ἱεράτευμα ἔθνος ἅγιον λαὸς εἰς περιποίησιν ὅπως τὰς ἀρετὰς ἐξαγγείλητε τοῦ ἐκ σκότους ὑμᾶς καλέσαντος εἰς τὸ θαυμαστὸν αὐτοῦ φῶς
verses.transliteration: Hymeis de genos eklekton basileion hierateuma ethnos hagion laos eis peripoiēsin hopōs tas aretas exangeilēte tou ek skotous hymas kalesantos eis to thaumaston autou phōs
verses.literal: But you are a chosen people a royal priesthood a holy nation a people for God’s own possession to proclaim the virtues of Him who called you out of darkness into His marvelous light

verses.original: οἵ ποτε οὐ λαὸς νῦν δὲ λαὸς Θεοῦ οἱ οὐκ ἠλεημένοι νῦν δὲ ἐλεηθέντες
verses.transliteration: hoi pote ou laos nyn de laos Theou hoi ouk ēleēmenoi nyn de eleēthentes
verses.literal: Once you were not a people but now you are the people of God once you had not received mercy but now you have received mercy

verses.original: Ἀγαπητοί παρακαλῶ ὡς παροίκους καὶ παρεπιδήμους ἀπέχεσθαι τῶν σαρκικῶν ἐπιθυμιῶν αἵτινες στρατεύονται κατὰ τῆς ψυχῆς
verses.transliteration: Agapētoi parakalō hōs paroikous kai parepidēmous apechesthai tōn sarkikōn epithymiōn haitines strateuontai kata tēs psychēs
verses.literal: Beloved I urge you as foreigners and exiles to abstain from the desires of the flesh which war against your soul

verses.original: τὴν ἀναστροφὴν ὑμῶν ἐν τοῖς ἔθνεσιν ἔχοντες καλήν ἵνα ἐν ᾧ καταλαλοῦσιν ὑμῶν ὡς κακοποιῶν ἐκ τῶν καλῶν ἔργων ἐποπτεύοντες δοξάσωσιν τὸν Θεὸν ἐν ἡμέρᾳ ἐπισκοπῆς
verses.transliteration: tēn anastrophēn hymōn en tois ethnesin echontes kalēn hina en hō katalalousin hymōn hōs kakopoiōn ek tōn kalōn ergōn epopteuontes doxasōsin ton Theon en hēmera episkopēs
verses.literal: Conduct . . . yourselves with such honor among the Gentiles that though they slander you as evildoers they may see your good deeds and glorify God on the day He visits us

verses.original: Ὑποτάγητε πάσῃ ἀνθρωπίνῃ κτίσει διὰ τὸν Κύριον εἴτε βασιλεῖ ὡς ὑπερέχοντι
verses.transliteration: Hypotagēte pasē anthrōpinē ktisei dia ton Kyrion eite basilei hōs hyperechonti
verses.literal: Submit yourselves for the Lord’s sake to every human institution whether to the king as the supreme authority

verses.original: εἴτε ἡγεμόσιν ὡς δι’ αὐτοῦ πεμπομένοις εἰς ἐκδίκησιν κακοποιῶν ἔπαινον δὲ ἀγαθοποιῶν
verses.transliteration: eite hēgemosin hōs di’ autou pempomenois eis ekdikēsin kakopoiōn epainon de agathopoiōn
verses.literal: or to governors as those sent by him to punish those who do wrong and to praise those who do right

verses.original: ὅτι οὕτως ἐστὶν τὸ θέλημα τοῦ Θεοῦ ἀγαθοποιοῦντας φιμοῦν τὴν τῶν ἀφρόνων ἀνθρώπων ἀγνωσίαν
verses.transliteration: hoti houtōs estin to thelēma tou Theou agathopoiountas phimoun tēn tōn aphronōn anthrōpōn agnōsian
verses.literal: For it is God’s will that by doing good you should silence the ignorance of foolish men

verses.original: ὡς ἐλεύθεροι καὶ μὴ ὡς ἐπικάλυμμα ἔχοντες τῆς κακίας τὴν ἐλευθερίαν ἀλλ’ ὡς Θεοῦ δοῦλοι
verses.transliteration: hōs eleutheroi kai mē hōs epikalymma echontes tēs kakias tēn eleutherian all’ hōs Theou douloi
verses.literal: Live in freedom but do not use your freedom as a cover-up for evil live as servants of God

verses.original: Πάντας τιμήσατε τὴν ἀδελφότητα ἀγαπᾶτε τὸν Θεὸν φοβεῖσθε τὸν βασιλέα τιμᾶτε
verses.transliteration: Pantas timēsate tēn adelphotēta agapate ton Theon phobeisthe ton basilea timate
verses.literal: Treat everyone with high regard . . . Love the brotherhood of believers fear God honor the king

verses.original: Οἱ οἰκέται ὑποτασσόμενοι ἐν παντὶ φόβῳ τοῖς δεσπόταις οὐ μόνον τοῖς ἀγαθοῖς καὶ ἐπιεικέσιν ἀλλὰ καὶ τοῖς σκολιοῖς
verses.transliteration: Hoi oiketai hypotassomenoi en panti phobō tois despotais ou monon tois agathois kai epieikesin alla kai tois skoliois
verses.literal: Servants submit yourselves to your masters with all respect not only to those who are good and gentle but even to those who are unreasonable

verses.original: τοῦτο γὰρ χάρις εἰ διὰ συνείδησιν Θεοῦ ὑποφέρει τις λύπας πάσχων ἀδίκως
verses.transliteration: touto gar charis ei dia syneidēsin Theou hypopherei tis lypas paschōn adikōs
verses.literal: For if anyone endures the pain of unjust suffering because he is conscious of God this is to be commended

verses.original: ποῖον γὰρ κλέος εἰ ἁμαρτάνοντες καὶ κολαφιζόμενοι ὑπομενεῖτε ἀλλ’ εἰ ἀγαθοποιοῦντες καὶ πάσχοντες ὑπομενεῖτε τοῦτο χάρις παρὰ Θεῷ
verses.transliteration: poion gar kleos ei hamartanontes kai kolaphizomenoi hypomeneite all’ ei agathopoiountes kai paschontes hypomeneite touto charis para Theō
verses.literal: How is it to your credit if you are beaten for doing wrong and you endure it But if you suffer for doing good and you endure it this is commendable before God

verses.original: Εἰς τοῦτο γὰρ ἐκλήθητε ὅτι καὶ Χριστὸς ἔπαθεν ὑπὲρ ὑμῶν ὑμῖν ὑπολιμπάνων ὑπογραμμὸν ἵνα ἐπακολουθήσητε τοῖς ἴχνεσιν αὐτοῦ
verses.transliteration: Eis touto gar eklēthēte hoti kai Christos epathen hyper hymōn hymin hypolimpanōn hypogrammon hina epakolouthēsēte tois ichnesin autou
verses.literal: For to this . . . you were called because Christ also suffered for you leaving you an example that you should follow in His footsteps

verses.original: Ὃς ἁμαρτίαν οὐκ ἐποίησεν οὐδὲ εὑρέθη δόλος ἐν τῷ στόματι αὐτοῦ
verses.transliteration: Hos hamartian ouk epoiēsen oude heurethē dolos en tō stomati autou
verses.literal: He committed no sin and no deceit was found in His mouth

verses.original: ὃς λοιδορούμενος οὐκ ἀντελοιδόρει πάσχων οὐκ ἠπείλει παρεδίδου δὲ τῷ κρίνοντι δικαίως
verses.transliteration: hos loidoroumenos ouk anteloidorei paschōn ouk ēpeilei paredidou de tō krinonti dikaiōs
verses.literal: When they heaped abuse on Him He did not retaliate when He suffered He made no threats but entrusted Himself to Him who judges justly

verses.original: ὃς τὰς ἁμαρτίας ἡμῶν αὐτὸς ἀνήνεγκεν ἐν τῷ σώματι αὐτοῦ ἐπὶ τὸ ξύλον ἵνα ταῖς ἁμαρτίαις ἀπογενόμενοι τῇ δικαιοσύνῃ ζήσωμεν Οὗ τῷ μώλωπι ἰάθητε
verses.transliteration: hos tas hamartias hēmōn autos anēnenken en tō sōmati autou epi to xylon hina tais hamartiais apogenomenoi tē dikaiosynē zēsōmen Hou tō mōlōpi iathēte
verses.literal: He Himself bore our sins in His body on the tree so that we might die to sin and live to righteousness By His stripes you are healed

verses.original: Ἦτε γὰρ ὡς πρόβατα πλανώμενοι ἀλλὰ ἐπεστράφητε νῦν ἐπὶ τὸν Ποιμένα καὶ Ἐπίσκοπον τῶν ψυχῶν ὑμῶν
verses.transliteration: Ēte gar hōs probata planōmenoi alla epestraphēte nyn epi ton Poimena kai Episkopon tōn psychōn hymōn
verses.literal: For you were like sheep going astray but now you have returned to the Shepherd and Overseer of your souls
